'''Stevan Gedarien''' is [[Warder]] to [[Demira Eriff]]. He is [[Cairhienin]].

== Appearance ==
He has gray at his temples. He is slender and 5'6" or 168&nbsp;cm tall, half a head shorter than Demira.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Stevan Gedarien|Stevan}}{{Ref/book|6|46}}

== History ==
He was born in Cairhien in {{ne|950}}.{{Ref/book|6|46}}{{ref||Stevan}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Demira Eriff}}

With an age difference of twenty years, Demira is old enough to be his mother, but he treats her more like a father.{{ref||Stevan}}

== Activities ==
He feels Demira's injury when she is attacked by a false Aiel in [[Caemlyn]] and leads [[Merana Ambrey]] and [[Berenecia Morsad]] to her go to her so she can be [[Healing|Healed]]. He is with her when she awakens.{{Ref/book|6|46}}
